messages:
Taylor: Hey @Rae — congrats on the new hire! Dropping a short "manager welcome script", a compact 7-day onboarding sprint, and a measurable 30/60/90 you can paste into the offer / calendar invites. Keep it lightweight. :tada:

Taylor:
```
Manager welcome script (one-liner + 2 lines):
- One-liner: "Mika joins as a Runtime Engineer focused on serving performance and reliability."
- 2-line expansion: "They'll work with the runtime team on batching, caching, and latency improvements. Please say hi and offer pairing time in the first week."

7-day sprint (calendar-friendly):
Day -1: Provision 1Password, SSO + MFA, GSuite, Slack; confirm hardware shipping
Day 0: 15m welcome, meet buddy (Owen), quick product + infra overview (45m)
Day 1: Local dev setup with buddy (2h), access review (model store, logs, DB)
Day 2: Pair on an onboarding-safe issue (label: first-timers), CI flow walkthrough
Day 3: Observability & tracing demo (30m), small metric or doc task assigned
Day 4: Ship first small PR, staging deploy check, 1:1 recap and 30/60/90 draft
Day 5: Team lunch intro (optional), schedule 30-day retro, finalize goals

30/60/90 (runtime, with acceptance criteria):
- 30 days: Dev env + infra access ready; 1 merged PR improving docs or fixing a minor infra bug. (AC: CI green, reviewer sign-off, staging deploy verified)
- 60 days: Own a subcomponent (e.g., KV cache tuning) and ship a measurable change. (AC: metric Y improved by >=5% or reduced alert noise by N)
- 90 days: Lead rollout of an optimization and be primary on a rotation. (AC: runbook updated, post-rollout postmortem prepared, zero P0 regressions in 2 weeks)
```

Taylor: Also included a short "who-to-ask" quick list below for common blocks.

Rae: This is great. Can you add a copyable intro blurb (short + fun fact) I can use in #company and #eng-runtime? Also need wording for the calendar invites.

Taylor: Sure — copy/paste blurb: "Mika joins Redwood as a Runtime Engineer working on serving perf. Previously at FluxScale. Fun fact: builds synthwave playlists. Welcome Mika! :wave:"

Taylor (continued): Calendar invite title suggestions: "Welcome Mika — Runtime 1:1" and "Pairing: local setup with Owen". Attach the fillable 30/60/90 doc and add acceptance criteria bullets to each calendar item.

Mika: Quick q — laptop tracker shows "label created" and hardware ETA unknown. Also who approves Dedicated GPU dev quota for experiments?

IT Support: Hi @Mika — carrier update: pickup scheduled, ETA 36 hours. Please DM preferred delivery window. If delayed beyond 48h we'll overnight.

eng-infra: For Dedicated GPU quota, raise an eng-infra ticket with prefix "onboard-gpu" and CC @Rae. We'll fast-track a dev quota for 30 days once approved. Limit default: 1 GPU.

Owen (Buddy): Mika — I'll DM a 30-min repo tour slot and add two safe starter PRs to the onboarding board. Also will create a small checklist in the onboarding repo for local setup steps.

OnboardingBot: Reminder scheduled: Security Foundations course will DM Mika on day 1; Data Handling course DM on day 8. Target: basic by EOD day 3, full by day 14.

Rae: I'll post the intro in #company and #eng-runtime after Taylor's blurb. Also scheduling weekly 1:1s for first 6 weeks and a 30-day retro on Friday week 2 at 10am.

Taylor: Heads-up for manager: create an onboarding-safe issue in the repo and tag reviewers ahead of time; add Mika to #eng-runtime, #eng, and optional #dedicated-access. If anything blocks, prefix tickets with "onboard-urgent".

Mika: Thanks everyone  excited to start. One last ask: who signs off on KMS/HSM access for private deploy testing?

Rae: Raise a ticket to Security with "onboard-kms" and CC me. We'll queue the access review early in week 1.

IT Support: Noted  will update hardware tracking and DM when shipped.

Taylor: Filing the fillable 30/60/90 to your calendar and posting the manager welcome script in the HR playbook. Ping if you want a role-specific copy with exact metrics. :white_check_mark:
